posts.html:
Three moves that make a 12 m² room feel generous.

We visited homes, workshops and showrooms to find out what makes a room work.

What we learned

  • Start with how you use the room
  • Buy fewer, better pieces
  • Leave space for the things you love
A room is finished when nothing in it is waiting to be replaced.
